releaseNotes:
- Agent now recovers more reliably from temporary model congestion while keeping one bounded recovery budget and showing the real failure when recovery cannot continue.
- Newly published model and Skill catalogs are picked up without disrupting active sessions, while saved conversations remain usable across catalog changes.
- Image attachments and previews stay available throughout live Agent conversations, including supported DeepSeek Flash image input.
- Story adaptation checks now derive choices, character introductions, world context, and review results from their authoritative project records more consistently.
- Recovered production failures no longer leave duplicate tools or stale failure cards, while independent failures keep their actionable evidence.
releaseNotesZh:
- Agent 现可更可靠地从临时模型拥堵中恢复，并统一控制恢复次数；无法继续时会展示真实失败原因。
- 新发布的模型与 Skill 目录可在不中断当前会话的情况下生效，目录变化后已保存对话仍可继续使用。
- 图片附件与预览会在 Agent 实时对话中持续保留，并支持可用的 DeepSeek Flash 图片输入。
- 故事改编检查现会更一致地从项目权威记录中读取选项、人物登场、世界背景与审查结论。
- 已恢复的生产失败不再遗留重复工具或过期失败卡片，独立失败仍会保留可操作的诊断证据。
